'''Jingzhi''' is an NPC in {{Location|Lake Heights}}.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Jingzhi:''' New faces... Are you from outside [[Jinzhou]]?
:{{DIcon}} You could say that.
:'''Jingzhi:''' I suppose you don't know how bad the war between Jinzhou and the [[Tacet Discord]]s was in the past.
:'''Jingzhi:''' Things are better now, but on the front lines, soldiers are still risking their lives every day.
:'''Jingzhi:''' Huh... Tell me, young friend, do you think I'll live to see the end of the war as a veteran?
:{{DIcon}} The war will never end.
::'''Jingzhi:''' Yes... the war never seems to end.
::'''Jingzhi:''' The soldiers will never disappear.
:{{DIcon}} You will live to see its end.
::'''Jingzhi:''' You think so...?
::'''Jingzhi:''' If I can't make it, young friend, please bear witness to that day for me.
:{{DIcon}} I don't know.
::'''Jingzhi:''' I had a dream last night. It was about a future without war.
::'''Jingzhi:''' When I woke up, I realized I was dreaming about the past.
:'''Jingzhi:''' I'm old now and have spent decades of my youth under fire.
:'''Jingzhi:''' These days, I'm just reminiscing. Please forgive this old man.
:'''Jingzhi:''' I'll stay a little longer... and then I'll be on my way.
{{Dialogue End}}
